subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The oldest lunch table in the cafeteria had many scratches.”?
options: A teacher even found her own name from when she had been a student.
The biology teacher said, "When people know the name of something, they often notice it more."
One student found an angry comment he had written two years earlier.
That night, the student felt less ashamed about her own difficult subjects.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「A teacher even found her own name from when she had been a student.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The biology teacher said, 'When people know the name of something, they often notice it more.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One student found an angry comment he had written two years earlier.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「That night, the student felt less ashamed about her own difficult subjects.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A teacher even found her own name from when she had been a student.」，答案為「A teacher even found her own name from when she had been a student.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A teacher even found her own name from when she had been a student.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
